text: Business Administration is a comprehensive discipline (professional code: 120201K) centered on enterprise operation and management, strategic decision-making, and organizational optimization. It belongs to the category of management, with a four-year duration of study and a Bachelor of Management degree awarded upon completion. This major integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as economics, psychology, sociology, and statistics, focusing on studying how enterprises achieve optimal resource allocation and value creation through functions such as planning, organizing, leading, and controlling. Its application scenarios cover all kinds of organizations (enterprises, non-profit institutions, government departments), and it is a fundamental major for cultivating business leaders and management talents.
